page_title: SOU 1-3 BOU | Southampton v Bournemouth 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Jarred Gillett is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Southampton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

90+6' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Cameron Archer (Southampton) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Kepa Arrizabalaga pulls off a comfortable save.
90+4' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
90+2' Southampton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth) comes onto the pitch for Dango Ouattara.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) will replace Ryan Christie.
85' Here is a change. Kamaldeen Sulemana is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Cameron Archer (Southampton).
85' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Joe Aribo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ryan Manning (Southampton).
83' 1 - 3 Goal - 1:3! Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Antoine Semenyo provided an assist for the goal.
82' A pass from Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) is intercepted by Kepa Arrizabalaga and the move breaks down.
80' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
78' The foul by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jarred Gillett.
77' That's the end of the game for Justin Kluivert, who is replaced by Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
76' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
74' James Bree (Southampton) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
73' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

72' 1 - 2 Goal! Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) takes a short pass from Paul Onuachu in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
71' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) comes onto the pitch so that David Brooks can be given a rest.
66' Neat passing move from Bournemouth in order to create new attacking opportunities.
63' A clever short pass gives Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
60' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
56' Substitution. William Smallbone will be replaced by Tyler Dibling (Southampton).
55' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
55' Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
54' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly over the crossbar.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Southampton comes to nothing.
52' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
49' The free kick evades the keeper and presents Paul Onuachu (Southampton) with an almost open goal, but he somehow heads well wide of the left post from close in.
49' It seemed like William Smallbone (Southampton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
46' Ivan Juric prepares a substitution. Nathan Wood is replaced by Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Ivan Juric gives a chance to Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) and Welington is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' The ball possession is 37:63.
42' The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner.

42' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Aaron Ramsdale leaps like a salmon to deny him. Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
41' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
39' It seemed like William Smallbone (Southampton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
38' Nathan Wood (Southampton) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just over the bar.
32' A yellow card for a tackle by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth). Jarred Gillett doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
32' Some great controlled play and passing from Bournemouth. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
30' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Aaron Ramsdale was alert and made a comfortable save.
28' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) attempts to release David Brooks with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
25' David Brooks (Bournemouth) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
21' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
21' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
20' Shots on target – 0:2.

16' 0 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) and Justin Kluivert gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 0:2.

14' 0 - 1 Ryan Christie showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom right corner. It's 0:1.
10' The referee Jarred Gillett awards William Smallbone (Southampton) a yellow card.
10' Southampton are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
8' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
7' The ball is cleared after Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) smashes the ball upfield and Lewis Cook brings it down with a fine first touch.
4' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) and Joe Aribo matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
2' David Brooks (Bournemouth) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
1' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Bournemouth will take the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett was nominated as the referee for this game.
